fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "waveedit.dll", which is part of the Nero WaveEditor audio editing software.
fields.name: Potential Waveedit.DLL Sideloading
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\waveedit.dll" and (not ((src.process.image.path in ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Nero\\Nero Apps\\Nero WaveEditor\\waveedit.exe","C:\\Program Files\\Nero\\Nero Apps\\Nero WaveEditor\\waveedit.exe")) and (module.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Nero\\Nero Apps\\Nero WaveEditor\\" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\Nero\\Nero Apps\\Nero WaveEditor\\")))))
